questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 14 cm and a height of 9 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 14 × 9 = 63 cm². Always halve after multiplying base by height — that's the step rushing skips.

questions.subject: D&T
questions.prompt: A drink brand redesigns its can with bold colours and a lightning bolt to stand out on shelves. What design factor is this mainly about?
questions.why: Bold colours and eye-catching graphics are about visual appeal — making the product stand out and attract attention on the shelf.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is the name for a substance the body produces to specifically target and destroy a pathogen?
questions.why: Antibodies are produced by lymphocytes to specifically recognise and destroy a particular pathogen.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: A cereal box uses cartoon characters and bright colours aimed at kids. What technique is this?
questions.why: Cartoon characters and bright colours are designed to appeal directly to children, making them pester parents to buy. The other options describe real but different marketing tactics not shown here.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.prompt: A young couple leaves a war-torn country and is granted permanent protection to live in Australia. What type of migrant are they?
questions.why: A refugee flees danger such as war or persecution and is granted protection, unlike an economic migrant who moves mainly for jobs.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Order these events of the 1923 Munich Putsch
sequence: Hitler declares a national revolution in a beer hall
Police open fire on the marchers
Hitler is arrested and put on trial
questions.why: The putsch began with Hitler's beer hall declaration, led to a march, ended in gunfire from police, and finished with Hitler's arrest and trial.
